Its generator yields the exact degree-two/four stationary recurrences; the stated rational kurtosis denominator is positive for q,z>0 and numerator P(q,z) is quadratic with positive-leading coefficient exactly at z>8/3. The all-positive B,H coefficients prove a unique positive q root and signed regions, including a bounded non-Gaussian zero-cumulant law. Exact independent symbolic identity against a separately published same-model fourth-cumulant polynomial confirms normalization: P_x(q/4,z/2)=−P(q,z)/32; this strongly corroborates C rather than conferring originality.
